steps.title: Identify the quadratic
steps.speech: This is a quadratic in standard form. [[beat]] a is one, b is negative five, and c is six.

steps.title: Find two numbers
steps.explanation: Find two numbers that multiply to $6$ and add to $-5$.
steps.speech: Find two numbers that multiply to six and add to negative five. [[beat]] Those numbers are negative two and negative three.

steps.title: Split the middle term
steps.speech: Rewrite the middle term using negative two and negative three. [[beat]] Split it into those two terms.

steps.title: Factor by grouping
steps.explanation: Group the four terms and pull out the common binomial.
steps.speech: Group the four terms and pull out the common binomial. [[beat]] First, group them. [[beat]] That factors into a pair of binomials equal to zero.

steps.title: Solve for x
steps.explanation: Set each factor equal to zero.
steps.speech: Set each factor equal to zero. [[beat]] One solution is x equals two. One solution is x equals three.

steps.title: Verify
steps.explanation: Substitute each root back into the original equation.
steps.speech: Substitute each root back into the original equation.
